headline: HSC candidate dies after jumping off six-storey building in Mymensingh
summary: The 18-year-old student reportedly took her own life hours before her examinations were scheduled to begin across Bangladesh.
details: An 18-year-old Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) candidate, Tisha Sarkar, died after reportedly jumping from the roof of a six-storey building in Mymensingh city on Thursday morning.
The incident occurred around 6am at NASA Tower near Kachijhuli Mosque Road, approximately four hours before the exams were set to start at 10am.
Tisha, a student of Alamgir Monsur Memorial College, had been living in a female students' hostel within the building for the past two years.
She was rushed to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital in critical condition, where doctors declared her dead on arrival.
Police recovered the body and sent it to the hospital morgue for a postmortem examination to determine the exact cause of death.
ASP Ashraful Karim stated that preliminary investigations suggest the death was a suicide.
Investigators are now examining whether exam-related mental pressure or other personal reasons contributed to the tragic incident.
caption:
An 18-year-old HSC candidate died in Mymensingh after reportedly jumping from a six-storey building just hours before her exams.

An 18-year-old Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) candidate, Tisha Sarkar, died after reportedly jumping from the roof of a six-storey building in Mymensingh city on Thursday morning.

The incident occurred around 6am at NASA Tower near Kachijhuli Mosque Road, approximately four hours before the exams were set to start at 10am.

Tisha, a student of Alamgir Monsur Memorial College, had been living in a female students' hostel within the building for the past two years.

She was rushed to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital in critical condition, where doctors declared her dead on arrival.

Police recovered the body and sent it to the hospital morgue for a postmortem examination to determine the exact cause of death.

ASP Ashraful Karim stated that preliminary investigations suggest the death was a suicide.

Investigators are now examining whether exam-related mental pressure or other personal reasons contributed to the tragic incident.

headline: Russian couple arrested after climbing Empire State Building for marriage proposal
summary: The pair scaled the 102-story skyscraper to display a banner with a message of love and peace.
details: A Russian couple was arrested after they climbed to the top of the Empire State Building in New York City to stage a daring marriage proposal.
The couple scaled the 102-story skyscraper, reaching the spire to display a large banner.
The banner read: 'When the power of love beats the love of power, the world knows peace.'
Police intervened and took the couple into custody after they reached the summit of the iconic landmark.
The stunt was designed as a high-profile romantic gesture, but it ended with the pair being detained by authorities.
caption:
